title: Grateful Dead Live at Merramec Community College on 1970-05-14
lineage: DAT > CDR > EAC > FLAC (with portions from MSR > MP3 > WAV > FLAC)

ai_review.summary: A rough, rowdy and furious Lovelight performance captured on a soundboard, highlighted by the rare "Rock the Pig" outburst.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave that this set contains perhaps the best Lovelight ever heard – fast, furious and full of raw energy. The soundboard source preserves that intensity, and the quirky "ROCK THE PIG!!" chant after the drum break adds a memorable moment, though some other copies appear to have edited it out.

ai_rating.rationale: The single 5‑star review praises the musical performance highly and notes no serious recording flaws, yielding a strong show rating; limited data (one review) lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Soundboard capture retains raw, rough energy; no specific clarity issues mentioned, though other copies show edited crowd sections.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Not detailed in reviews; focus is on the high‑energy Lovelight and its unique post‑drum chant.
